description: This file contains classes and methods related to benchmarking message queuing performance using SQL Server in an Orleans streaming context. It defines benchmark setup, parameters for testing degradation factors, and methods to queue stream messages as part of performance testing.

classes.name: SqlServerMessageQueueingBenchmark
classes.description: A specific benchmark class for SQL Server message queuing, inheriting from MessageQueueingBenchmark, with setup routine clearing connection pools.

classes.name: MessageQueueingBenchmark
classes.description: An abstract base class defining the benchmarking setup for message queueing, parameterized by database invariants, with variables for payload, queue IDs, and concurrency settings.

methods.name: GlobalSetup
methods.description: Initializes the testing environment, including resetting connection pools and setting up storage and queries.

methods.name: IterationSetup
methods.description: Prepares the database for each benchmarking iteration by truncating message table.

methods.name: QueueStreamMessage
methods.description: Performs the core benchmarking operation of queueing stream messages in parallel, testing throughput under specified parameters.
